correctness.rationale: All quantifiers fixed: characteristic zero and every \(m\ge3\). The open leaf-diagonal chart is a domain because the Schur-complement bilinear form has rank >=2. Exact boundary strata t=1,2,3,>=4 have ambient codimension >=4; Deng-Kretschmer Theorem 1 supplies radical, Cohen-Macaulay, height-three, excluding hidden components. Primality follows; generic local node follows from independent Schur coordinates. The exact-rational checker ran successfully (VERIFY_OK) and is explicitly not treated as an all-m proof.

originality.rationale: The all-size \(K_{2,m}\) submaximal-minor primality theorem is not entailed by the published radicality/height-three theorem or the known forest-zero-pattern primality theorem. The original paper poses the two-connected-graph primality question and only reports computation up through six vertices. Actual targeted searches were made; originality remains qualified by incomplete literature exhaustiveness.
residual_risks: Not an exhaustive search of all post-2022 papers or theses; an identical K_{2,m} specialization could exist outside the surfaced literature.
The 2011 source is historical general sparse-determinantal context; the precise symmetric graph-specialized open question appeared in later literature.
Only the stated generic transverse singularity is classified, not special boundary singularities.
